description_en: Creates an external community sample for the risk identification service
description_zh: 用于风险识别服务的社群样本外部创建
kebab_example: aliyun safconsole send-feedback --sample-type PHONE --risk-label OTHERS --value 10000000000 --reason Abnormal_transaction_behavior. --api-version 2021-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendFeedback

parameters.help_en: The sample type. Set this parameter to PHONE for phone number samples, EMAIL for email samples, or ACCOUNT for account samples
parameters.help_zh: 样本类型。手机号类型样本需传入PHONE，邮箱类型样本需传入EMAIL，账户类型样本需传入ACCOUNT
parameters.name: sample_type

parameters.help_en: The sample labels. User-defined, separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 样本标签。用户自定义，以逗号分隔
parameters.name: risk_label
